event.wandering_smith.title: The Wandering Smith
event.wandering_smith.body: A smith with a cart of tools offers to work your steel for coin.
event.cursed_anvil.title: The Cursed Anvil
event.cursed_anvil.body: An anvil hums with dark power. Striking it could forge something great — or something wrong.
event.cursed_anvil.opt0: Strike it (gain 2 Essence, gain a curse).
event.cursed_anvil.opt1: Pry loose the rune inlay (random rare rune).
event.ember_spring.title: Ember Spring
event.ember_spring.body: Molten water bubbles from the ground, warm and restorative.
event.ember_spring.opt1: Quench a core in it (random fire-aspected core item).
event.bandit_toll.title: Bandit Toll
event.bandit_toll.body: Forge bandits block the road and demand payment.
event.bandit_toll.opt2: Sneak around (60%: free; else lose 15% HP).
event.overgrown_shrine.title: Overgrown Shrine
event.overgrown_shrine.body: Vines cradle a shrine to a forgotten harvest god.
event.spore_cloud.title: Spore Cloud
event.spore_cloud.body: A drifting cloud of spores glows faintly green.
event.spore_cloud.opt0: Breathe deep (+8 max HP, lose 10% HP).
event.frozen_courier.title: Frozen Courier
event.frozen_courier.body: A courier lies frozen, satchel still clutched.
event.ice_mirror.title: The Ice Mirror
event.ice_mirror.body: Your reflection in the ice holds a different weapon.
event.bone_merchant.title: The Bone Merchant
event.bone_merchant.body: A skeletal merchant offers discounts — for a price.
event.bone_merchant.opt1: Buy a relic (50 gold: random rare relay/support).
event.restless_dead.title: Restless Dead
event.restless_dead.body: Spirits beg you to lay their bones to rest.
event.restless_dead.opt1: Plunder the tomb (+60 gold, crypt elite fight).
event.storm_conduit.title: Storm Conduit
event.storm_conduit.body: Lightning arcs between two pylons, pulsing with stored power.
event.clockwork_vault.title: Clockwork Vault
event.clockwork_vault.body: A vault ticks. Its lock resets every few seconds.
event.forge_spirit.title: Forge Spirit
event.forge_spirit.body: A spirit of the forge offers to widen your workbench.
event.gambler.title: The Gambler
event.gambler.body: A grinning gambler shuffles cards: double or nothing.
event.gambler.opt1: Bet your blood (50%: 2 Essence; else 20% damage).
event.abandoned_camp.title: Abandoned Camp
event.abandoned_camp.body: A cold campfire and scattered supplies.
event.rune_scholar.title: Rune Scholar
event.rune_scholar.body: A scholar studies your weapons with great interest.
event.mysterious_crate.title: Mysterious Crate
event.mysterious_crate.body: A sealed crate marked with a forgemaster's sigil.
event.blood_altar.title: Blood Altar
event.blood_altar.body: An altar asks for blood in exchange for strength.
event.lost_apprentice.title: Lost Apprentice
event.lost_apprentice.body: A young apprentice asks to be escorted home.
event.lost_apprentice.opt1: Take their toolkit (random support piece, curse).
event.whispering_blade.title: Whispering Blade
event.whispering_blade.body: A blade embedded in stone whispers promises.
event.whispering_blade.opt0: Pull it free (random rare modifier, 15% damage).
event.traveling_bazaar.title: Traveling Bazaar
event.traveling_bazaar.body: Merchants set up stalls; bargains abound for the patient.
event.traveling_bazaar.opt1: Sell spare parts (lose a random item, +55 gold).
event.ancient_forge.title: Ancient Forge
event.ancient_forge.body: A forge older than kingdoms still burns with blue fire.
event.ancient_forge.opt1: Draw essence from the flames (+1 Essence).
event.hermit_alchemist.title: Hermit Alchemist
event.hermit_alchemist.body: A hermit brews potions in a hollow tree.
event.hermit_alchemist.opt0: Drink the red draught (+10 max HP).
event.hermit_alchemist.opt1: Drink the black draught (60%: blessing; else curse).
event.shrine_of_steel.title: Shrine of Steel
event.shrine_of_steel.body: Blades of fallen warriors ring softly in the wind.
event.shrine_of_steel.opt1: Take a blade (random blade modifier: serrated).
event.eclipse_omen.title: Eclipse Omen
event.eclipse_omen.body: The sun darkens; light and shadow trade places.
event.gale_crossing.title: Gale Crossing
event.gale_crossing.body: A rope bridge sways in a howling gale.
event.gale_crossing.opt0: Cross quickly (70%: wind core; else 15% damage).
event.void_rift.title: Void Rift
event.training_dummy.title: Old Training Yard
event.training_dummy.body: Battered dummies stand in neat rows.
event.merchant_caravan.title: Merchant Caravan
event.merchant_caravan.body: A caravan seeks guards for the road ahead.
event.well_of_echoes.title: Well of Echoes
event.well_of_echoes.body: Your voice returns twice as loud.
event.broken_golem.title: Broken Golem
event.broken_golem.body: A broken golem's core still glows.
event.healing_grove.title: Healing Grove
event.healing_grove.body: Soft light filters through ancient leaves.
event.arcane_library.title: Arcane Library
event.arcane_library.body: Shelves of spellbooks hover in the air.
event.smugglers_den.title: Smuggler's Den
event.smugglers_den.body: Smugglers sell contraband relays, no questions asked.
event.smugglers_den.opt0: Buy contraband (40 gold: random rare piece).
event.starfall_crater.title: Starfall Crater
event.starfall_crater.body: A fallen star still radiates warmth.
event.weapon_rack.title: Abandoned Armory
event.weapon_rack.body: Racks of weapons, most rusted beyond use.
event.duelist_challenge.title: A Duelist's Challenge
event.duelist_challenge.body: A masked duelist challenges you to single combat.
event.duelist_challenge.opt0: Accept (elite fight, then a blessing choice).
event.tinkers_gift.title: Tinker's Gift
event.tinkers_gift.body: A tinker trades gadgets for interesting stories.
event.tinkers_gift.opt1: Tell of your defeats (amplifier relay, 10% damage).
event.fortune_teller.title: Fortune Teller
event.fortune_teller.body: She reads the path ahead in molten glass.
event.sacrificial_forge.title: Sacrificial Forge
event.sacrificial_forge.body: Feed it an item; it returns something stranger.
event.sacrificial_forge.opt0: Sacrifice an item (lose random item, gain random rare modifier).
event.ghostly_smith.title: Ghostly Smith
event.ghostly_smith.body: A ghost hammers at an anvil that isn't there.
event.ghostly_smith.opt0: Help finish its work (+1 Essence, temper a weapon).
event.crystal_cavern.title: Crystal Cavern
event.crystal_cavern.body: Crystals hum in resonance with your relays.
event.mercenary_offer.title: Mercenary Offer
event.mercenary_offer.body: A mercenary offers to share battle tricks.
event.purifying_flame.title: Purifying Flame
event.purifying_flame.body: A white flame burns away corruption — and some flesh.
